source_evidence.claim: The old action conflated shore-to-sea spatial order with incoming-wave propagation; correction preserves reef zonation.

sources.use: Original stored research pointer; identifies sheltered flat, exposed crest and deeper fore reef. Spatial list is not a propagation sequence.
Offshore reef breaking dissipates wave energy before shoreline, supporting sheltered landward flat.
Distinguishes crest breaking and flat wave conditions from ebb-driven offshore water/sediment transport.
Ebb denotes falling-tide current moving seaward; current and incoming wave direction must remain distinct.

source_evidence.limitations: No quantitative energy, depth, ecological-health, pixel or universal-current claim.

fresh_verification.evidence: NOAA orders reef flat, crest, fore reef spatially from shore to sea. It places the flat on the sheltered side, describes incoming-wave exposure at the crest, and the fore reef sloping deeper. This spatial ordering is not an incoming-wave travel sequence.
fresh_verification.limits: The page also describes energy dissipation on the fore reef. The correction selects one supported crest-breaking/sheltered-flat scene; it does not disallow other dissipation or transport.

fresh_verification.evidence: USGS shows offshore reef breaking and energy dissipation before the shoreline, supporting the landward reduction of wave energy represented in the proposed sentence.
fresh_verification.limits: No numerical reduction, exact depth, or ecological-health claim is added.

fresh_verification.evidence: The Molokai observations distinguish wave breaking at the crest from water and sediment transport. Higher tide can admit greater ocean-wave energy to the flat and support locally generated waves; during ebb, water and suspended sediment drain offshore.
fresh_verification.limits: Supports preserving tide/wind variability and ebb-current alternatives rather than treating the corrected source scene as universal.

fresh_verification.evidence: NOAA defines flood as incoming tidal current and ebb as outgoing current. That current distinction does not reverse the proposed incoming-surf scene.
fresh_verification.limits: Ebb coexistence queries remain controls with no low-rank requirement.
